book.name: Lea Fakatātā
book.title: KO E TOHI ʻOE NGAAHI LEA FAKATĀTĀ

content.text: ‌ʻIkai ʻoku kalanga ʻae poto? Pea ʻai mai ʻe he faʻa ʻilo hono leʻo?
‌ʻOku tuʻu ia ʻi he tumutumu ʻoe ngaahi potu māʻolunga,
mo e ngaahi potu ʻi he ngaahi veʻe hala.
‌ʻOku ne kalanga ʻi he ngaahi matapā,
mo e ngaahi matanikolo, ʻi he ava ʻoe ngaahi matapā.
“ʻAe kau tangata, ʻoku ou ui kiate kimoutolu!
Pea ʻoku hiki hake hoku leʻo ki he fānau ʻae tangata,
‌ʻAe kau sesele, mou ʻilo ʻae poto:
pea ke maʻu ʻekimoutolu, ko e kau vale, ʻae loto faʻa ʻilo.
Fanongo; he te u lea ki he ngaahi meʻa ʻoku lelei;
pea ʻe mafaʻa hoku loungutu ʻi he ngaahi meʻa totonu.
Pea ʻe lea ʻaki ʻae moʻoni ʻe hoku ngutu;
pea ko e meʻa fakalielia ki hoku loungutu ʻae kovi.
‌ʻOku ʻi he māʻoniʻoni ʻae ngaahi lea kotoa pē ʻa hoku ngutu;
ʻoku ʻikai ha pikopiko pe ha kākā ʻi ai.
‌ʻOku ʻilongofua kotoa pē kiate ia ʻoku poto,
pea totonu kiate kinautolu ʻoku maʻu ʻae ʻilo.
Maʻuā ʻeku akonaki, kae siʻaki ʻae siliva;
pea ke lelei hake ʻae maʻu ʻoe ʻilo ʻi he koula lelei.
“He ʻoku lelei hake ʻae poto ʻi he ngaahi maka koloa;
pea ʻoku ʻikai faʻa tatau mo ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku ke faʻa holi ki ai.
Ko au poto ʻoku ma nonofo mo faʻa filioʻi,
pea u maʻu ʻae ʻilo ʻi he fakatupu meʻa foʻou.
Ko e manavahē kia Sihova, ko e fehiʻa ia ki he kovi:
ko e fielahi, mo e fakapuhopuhā, mo e angakovi mo e ngutu kovi, ʻoku ou fehiʻa ki ai.
‌ʻOku ʻaʻaku ʻae akonaki, mo e poto moʻoni:
ko au ko e faʻa ʻilo, ʻoku ʻiate au ʻae mālohi.
Ko e meʻa ʻiate au ʻoku pule ai ʻae ngaahi tuʻi,
pea fai fakamaau ʻe he houʻeiki.
‌ʻOku pule ʻae houʻeiki ʻiate au,
mo e kakai ʻeiki, mo e kau fakamaau kotoa pē ʻo māmani.
‌ʻOku ou ʻofa kiate kinautolu ʻoku ʻofa kiate au;
pea ʻe maʻu au ʻekinautolu ʻoku kumi tōtōaki kiate au.
‌ʻOku ʻiate au ʻae koloa mo e ongoongolelei;
ʻio, ʻae koloa taʻepopo mo e māʻoniʻoni.
‌ʻOku lelei hake ʻi he koula ʻa hoku fua, ʻio, ʻi he koula lelei;
mo ʻeku koloa ʻi he siliva lelei.
‌ʻOku ou takimuʻa ʻi he hala ʻoe māʻoniʻoni,
ʻi he loto hala ʻoe fakamaau:
Koeʻuhi ke u pule ke maʻu ʻae koloa moʻoni ʻekinautolu ʻoku ʻofa kiate au;
pea te u fakafonu honau tukunga koloa.
“Naʻe maʻu au ʻe Sihova ʻi he kamataʻanga ʻo hono hala,
ʻi muʻa ange ʻi heʻene ngaahi ngāue ʻi muʻa.
Naʻe fokotuʻu au talu mei muʻa, mei he kamataʻanga ʻi he teʻeki ai ʻa māmani.
Naʻe fanauʻi au ʻi he teʻeki ke ai ha loloto;
ʻi he teʻeki ai ha matavai ʻoku fonu ʻi he vai.
‌ʻI he teʻeki ke tuʻumaʻu ʻae ngaahi moʻunga;
naʻe fanauʻi au ʻi he teʻeki ai ʻae ngaahi potu māʻolunga:
‌ʻI he teʻeki ai te ne ngaohi ʻa māmani, pe ko e potu maʻalaʻala,
pe ko e potu lahi ʻoe efu ʻo māmani.
‌ʻI heʻene teuteu ʻae ngaahi langi, naʻaku ʻi ai au:
pea ʻi heʻene tuku ʻae ngataʻanga ʻoe funga loloto:
‌ʻI heʻene fokotuʻu ʻae ngaahi ʻao ʻi ʻolunga:
ʻi heʻene fakamālohi ʻae ngaahi matavai ʻoe loloto:
‌ʻI heʻene tuku ki he tahi ʻene fono,
ke ʻoua naʻa laka mai ia ʻi he meʻa kuo ne fekau:
ʻi heʻene tuʻutuʻuni ʻae ngaahi tuʻunga ʻo māmani.
Naʻaku ʻi ai mo ia, ʻo hangē ha taha kuo tupu hake mo ia:
ko hono fiefiaʻanga au ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē,
pe naʻaku fiefia maʻuaipē i hono ʻao;
Naʻaku fiefia ʻi he ngaahi potu ʻo māmani ʻoku kakai,
pea naʻe ʻi he fānau ʻae tangata ʻa ʻeku fiefiaʻanga.
“Ko ia, ʻE fānau, mou fanongo mai kiate au:
he ʻoku monūʻia ia ʻoku tokanga ki hoku ngaahi hala.
Mou fanongo ki he akonaki, pea mou poto,
pea ʻoua naʻa mou taʻetokanga ki ai.
‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae tangata ʻoku fanongo kiate au,
ʻo ne tatali ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē ʻi hoku ngaahi matapā,
ʻo ne nofo ʻi hoku veʻe matapā.
He ko ia ʻoku ne maʻu au ʻoku ne maʻu ʻae moʻui,
pea ʻe ʻiate ia ʻae ongoongolelei meia Sihova.”
Ka ko ia ʻoku fai angahala kiate au, ʻoku ne fai kovi ki hono laumālie ʻoʻona:
ʻoku ʻofa ki he mate ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku fehiʻa kiate au.
